chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
The master of food in this world and the Hereafter is meat, and the master of drink in this world and the Hereafter is water, and I am the master of the children of Adam, with no boast.
ai.seo_question: What are the best food and drink according to the Prophet in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights the Prophet’s dual role as a spiritual leader and a model of simplicity, elevating water and meat to their highest status while asserting his unique nobility as 'Sayyid al-Bashar' (Master of Humanity). The phrase 'wa la fakhara' (no boast) underscores the Shia understanding of his humility despite his supreme rank, a theme often linked to the Verse of Purification and the Event of Mubahala. It serves as a reminder that true greatness in Islam is rooted in both spiritual authority and grounded, simple living.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-78 According to the same documentation, God’s Prophet (S) said, “
The best food in this world and the Hereafter is meat. The best drink inthis world and the Hereafter is water. I am the Master of the children of Adam, but I am not arrogant.”
